subject: general
question: Which of the following universities won the Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy 2021?

options.text: Guru Jambheshwar University of Science and Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Panjab University.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy** is awarded to the overall best-performing university in inter-university tournaments in India.
 
• **Panjab University** has won this prestigious award a record **14 times**, including the latest win in 2021.
 
• Panjab University has a rich history and is one of the oldest universities in India, established in **1882.**
 
• It is located in the city of **Chandigarh **and offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs in various fields of study.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy bears **Abul Kalam Azad's** name.
 
• Every year, the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports **bestows this honor. 
 
• As of** 2020,** the trophy, which was first given out in 1956–1957, had been given out **64 times.** 
 
• The award has been won by** six universities** at different periods.
 
• The trophy has been won **24 times by Guru Nanak Dev University **in Amritsar, the most recent victory coming in 2023.
 
• While **Delhi University,** located in Delhi, has won the trophy** 14 times,** most recently in the years 2000–2001, **Panjab University, l**ocated in Chandigarh, has won it **15 times**, the most recent being in 2020.
 
• **Kurukshetra University in Kurukshetra, Punjabi University in Patiala, and Bombay University in Mumbai**—which took home the inaugural trophy—are among the other winners.
